items.hed: Texans signed Crumedy and Sobkowicz to the practice squad on Wednesday
items.insight: The club's Nov. 4 transactions note, posted at 10:12 a.m., signs defensive tackle Jaden Crumedy and wide receiver Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad and releases defensive tackle Kyonte Hamilton and tight end Zaire Mitchell-Paden. Houston's gameday page still points to Sunday, Nov. 8, at SoFi Stadium, against the Chargers.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Ed Schipul, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.

items.hed: Rockets visit the Suns Saturday at 9 p.m. Eastern
items.insight: The NBA league schedule lists Saturday, Nov. 7, as Houston at Phoenix, 9:00 p.m. Eastern, game 0022600194. Wednesday's game at Toyota Center is final on the same schedule: Minnesota at Houston, game 0022600181. The next home date after Saturday is Monday, Nov. 9, against Denver, 8:30 p.m. Eastern.

items.hed: Astros list Loperfido out for 2027 after late-October hip surgery
items.insight: MLB.com's Astros injuries and roster page, dated Nov. 2, says outfielder Joey Loperfido had arthroscopic surgery on his right hip in late October for a labral injury and hip impingement, with a return expected in 2027. The MLB transaction log from Nov. 1 through Nov. 5 still shows no Houston moves after Monday, when Carlos Correa, Mike Burrows, and Brandon Walter were activated and Evan Reifert was acquired from Tampa Bay for cash.
